related_questions.question: How do I inform the local council of a change of address?
related_questions.snippet: Visit your local municipality website and find the section related to council taxes. You will need to log in to the relevant portal using your credentials which you created when you initially registered. Once logged in, locate and click on the 'Change of Address' option or tab. Now simply enter your new address.

related_questions.question: How do I change my address for council tax in the UK?
related_questions.snippet: If you move to a new property or to a new area, tell your local council or tell the council for the new area you've moved to. If the property you've moved into doesn't have a Council Tax band, you'll need to contact your local council. They'll arrange for your property to be assessed. Search for your local council.
